description: Data layer — all Kotlin files under data/ and viewmodel/. Independent of FEAT-003 (UI screens); FEAT-003 depends on this. Implements Retrofit API client, data models matching the real Cloudflare Pages Functions API responses, DataStore session storage, repositories, and ViewModels with StateFlow. All based on the actual API contracts found in functions/api/.
steps: Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/data/api/models/Models.kt with all data classes in one file (fewer files, less boilerplate): data class AuthResponse(val logged_in: Boolean, val user: UserData? = null, val status: String? = null, val message: String? = null); data class UserData(val id: Int? = null, val username: String = "", val full_name: String = "", val role: String = "", val role_label: String = "", val sppg_name: String = "", val avatar: String? = null); data class TelemetriWrapper(val status: String, val data: TelemetriData); data class TelemetriData(val porsi_tersalurkan: Long = 0, val persen_target: Double = 0.0, val sppg_aktif: Int = 0, val sekolah_terlayani: Int = 0, val kepatuhan_akg: Double = 0.0, val suhu_rata_rata: Double = 0.0, val sla_distribusi: Double = 0.0, val pembaruan_teks: String = ""); data class DistribusiWrapper(val status: String, val data: List<ProvinsiData>); data class ProvinsiData(val provinsi: String = "", val target_porsi: Long = 0, val ketepatan: Double = 0.0, val status: String = "", val region_code: String = ""); data class MenuWrapper(val status: String, val date: String = "", val data: List<MenuData>); data class MenuData(val id: Int? = null, val sppg_name: String = "", val school_target: String = "", val city: String = "", val menu_title: String = "", val menu_date: String = "", val protein_g: Double? = null, val karbohidrat_g: Double? = null, val lemak_g: Double? = null, val kalori_kkal: Int? = null, val catatan: String? = null); data class NotifikasiData(val id: Int? = null, val badge_count: Int = 0, val laporan_masuk_count: Int = 0, val latest_reports: List<LaporanReport> = emptyList()); data class LaporanReport(val id: Int? = null, val ticket_code: String = "", val reporter_name: String = "", val school_target: String = "", val issue_category: String = "", val status: String = "", val created_at: String = ""); data class TiketWrapper(val status: String, val data: TiketData? = null, val message: String? = null); data class TiketData(val nomor_tiket: String = "", val kategori: String = "", val target_sekolah: String = "", val status: String = "", val priority: String = "", val tanggal_lapor: String = "", val nama_pelapor: String = "", val deskripsi: String = "", val catatan_satgas: String = ""); data class ChatResponse(val status: String, val reply: String = "", val session_id: String = "");

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/data/api/ApiService.kt — Retrofit interface. All endpoints require header X-Requested-By: mbg-radar (added globally in ApiClient): @GET("api/auth_user") suspend fun checkSession(): AuthResponse; @FormUrlEncoded @POST("api/auth_user") suspend fun login(@Field("action") action: String = "login", @Field("username") username: String, @Field("password") password: String): AuthResponse; @FormUrlEncoded @POST("api/auth_user") suspend fun register(@Field("action") action: String = "register", @Field("full_name") fullName: String, @Field("email") email: String, @Field("username") username: String, @Field("password") password: String, @Field("role") role: String, @Field("sppg_name") sppgName: String = ""): AuthResponse; @GET("api/telemetri") suspend fun getTelemetri(): TelemetriWrapper; @GET("api/distribusi") suspend fun getDistribusi(): DistribusiWrapper; @GET("api/menu") suspend fun getMenu(): MenuWrapper; @GET("api/notifications") suspend fun getNotifikasi(): NotifikasiData; @GET("api/tiket") suspend fun getTiket(@Query("tiket") tiket: String): TiketWrapper; @FormUrlEncoded @POST("api/live_chat") suspend fun sendChat(@Field("message") message: String, @Field("session_id") sessionId: String = ""): ChatResponse.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/data/api/ApiClient.kt — OkHttp + Retrofit singleton. Use a PersistentCookieJar-style manual CookieJar: store cookies in a thread-safe ConcurrentHashMap<String, List<Cookie>> keyed by host, implementing CookieJar with saveFromResponse and loadForRequest. Add a default header interceptor that adds 'X-Requested-By: mbg-radar' to every request. Add HttpLoggingInterceptor (level BODY in debug, NONE in release) using BuildConfig.DEBUG. Build OkHttpClient with 30s connect/read/write timeouts. Build Retrofit with base URL 'https://mbg.jack-ai.my.id/' and GsonConverterFactory. Expose as companion object val instance: ApiService (lazy). Also expose fun clearCookies() for logout.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/data/local/SessionDataStore.kt — DataStore Preferences wrapper. Context extension property val Context.dataStore: DataStore<Preferences> by preferencesDataStore(name = "radar_mbg_session"). Keys: IS_LOGGED_IN (booleanPreferencesKey), USERNAME (stringPreferencesKey), FULL_NAME (stringPreferencesKey), ROLE (stringPreferencesKey), SPPG_NAME (stringPreferencesKey). Methods: suspend fun saveSession(context, user: UserData), suspend fun clearSession(context), Flow<Boolean> isLoggedIn(context), Flow<UserData?> getUser(context).

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/data/repository/AuthRepository.kt — wraps ApiClient calls in runCatching. Methods: suspend fun checkSession(): Result<AuthResponse>; suspend fun login(username, password): Result<AuthResponse>; suspend fun register(fullName, email, username, password, role, sppgName): Result<AuthResponse>; suspend fun logout(): Result<Unit> (just clearCookies() on ApiClient). No Context dependency — DataStore persistence is handled in ViewModels.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/data/repository/DataRepository.kt — suspend fun getTelemetri(): Result<TelemetriData>; suspend fun getDistribusi(): Result<List<ProvinsiData>>; suspend fun getMenu(): Result<List<MenuData>>; suspend fun getNotifikasi(): Result<NotifikasiData>; suspend fun getTiket(tiketId: String): Result<TiketWrapper>; suspend fun sendChat(message: String): Result<ChatResponse>. All wrap ApiClient.instance calls in runCatching.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/viewmodel/AuthViewModel.kt. Sealed class AuthUiState: Idle, Loading, Success(val user: UserData), Error(val message: String), LoggedOut. class AuthViewModel(application: Application): AndroidViewModel(application). StateFlow<AuthUiState> _uiState = MutableStateFlow(Idle). val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow(). fun checkSession(): launch viewModelScope, emit Loading, call AuthRepository.checkSession(), on success if logged_in emit Success(user) else emit LoggedOut, on failure emit Error. fun login(username, password): launch, emit Loading, call AuthRepository.login(), on status=='success' save session via SessionDataStore.saveSession(getApplication(), user), emit Success, on failure emit Error with message from response. fun register(fullName, email, username, password, role, sppgName): similar pattern. fun logout(): launch, call AuthRepository.logout(), call SessionDataStore.clearSession(), emit LoggedOut.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/viewmodel/HomeViewModel.kt. Sealed class HomeUiState: Loading, Success(val telemetri: TelemetriData, val distribusi: List<ProvinsiData>), Error(val message: String). class HomeViewModel : ViewModel(). fun loadData(): launch viewModelScope, emit Loading, call both DataRepository.getTelemetri() and DataRepository.getDistribusi() in parallel with async/await, on both success emit Success, on any failure emit Error.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/viewmodel/MenuViewModel.kt. Sealed class MenuUiState: Loading, Success(val allItems: List<MenuData>, val filtered: List<MenuData>, val kotaList: List<String>, val selectedKota: String), Error(val message: String). fun loadMenu() and fun filterByKota(kota: String): if kota is empty/ALL show allItems else filter by city field.

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/viewmodel/LaporanViewModel.kt. Holds form state as individual MutableStateFlow fields (nama, telepon, role, kategori, sekolah, tanggal, deskripsi, photoUri). Sealed class TiketUiState: Idle, Loading, Found(val data: TiketData), NotFound, Error(val message: String). fun trackTiket(tiketId: String). fun submitLaporan(): calls live_chat API with formatted message as a workaround (no dedicated POST laporan endpoint in the functions API — the laporan form data is sent as a structured message to /api/live_chat with the form fields serialized as JSON in the message field; the AI responds with a confirmation and the client generates a local TKT reference ID).

Create android/app/src/main/java/id/go/bgn/radarmbg/viewmodel/NotifikasiViewModel.kt. Sealed class NotifikasiUiState: Loading, Success(val data: NotifikasiData), Error. fun loadNotifikasi(): calls DataRepository.getNotifikasi().
acceptance_criteria: Running .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug from android/ produces BUILD SUCCESSFUL
All new Kotlin files compile without errors — checked by Gradle's compileDebugKotlin task
ApiService.kt, ApiClient.kt, Models.kt, SessionDataStore.kt, both repositories, and all ViewModels exist at their specified paths
findings: Build succeeded after one fix: BuildConfig was unresolved because buildConfig = true was not set in buildFeatures. Added buildConfig = true to app/build.gradle alongside compose = true. All 11 files created: Models.kt (14 data classes), ApiService.kt (9 endpoints), ApiClient.kt (OkHttp singleton with ConcurrentHashMap CookieJar + X-Requested-By interceptor + debug logging), SessionDataStore.kt (DataStore Preferences wrapper with 5 keys), AuthRepository.kt, DataRepository.kt, AuthViewModel.kt (sealed AuthUiState: Idle/Loading/Success/Error/LoggedOut), HomeViewModel.kt (parallel async/await for telemetri+distribusi), MenuViewModel.kt (with filterByKota), LaporanViewModel.kt (form state + submitLaporan via live_chat + trackTiket), NotifikasiViewModel.kt. APK at android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk confirmed.
